planning.title: Sentry: An external self-improving failure management layer for LLM agents
planning.summary: Sentry runs alongside your agent loop to detect failures, guide recovery, and learn reusable lessons from verified recoveries. Sentry is an external runtime failure management layer for LLM agents. It helps agents fix invalid actions and recover when they get stuck in loops, drift from the task, or make unsupported assumptions. Unlike typical runtime monitors with fixed advice, Sentry learns and evolves from recoveries that work. By detecting failures, guiding recovery, and checking that the repair worked, Sentry helps agents become more reliable across tasks without cluttering their context.

memory.title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
memory.summary: Introduces Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT), a looped architecture that reuses keys and values as memory across loops, with a U-shaped variant reported to beat OLMo3 in 400B-token pretraining and to match its inference latency on ~113M models.

memory.title: TASK Memory: Beyond Text-Only Memory with Activation Steering and Knowledge Editing against Memory Hallucination
memory.summary: Proposes TASK memory, which pairs a text note with activation steering and a removable knowledge edit to reduce use-time memory hallucinations in frozen LLMs, reporting memory-ignoring errors cut to at most 1.5% across ten model-dataset cells.

memory.title: How Well Do Vision-Language Scene Graphs Serve as Memory for Embodied Question Answering?
memory.summary: The paper evaluates vision-language scene graphs as memory for embodied question answering, introducing an answerability metric and finding that repairs raising it from 27.2% to 37.4% do not always track gains in object F1 or QA accuracy.

memory.title: Find the Clue, Not the Scene: Rethinking Reasoning for Entity Recognition in Vision-Language Models
memory.summary: Analyzing thinking vision-language models on knowledge-based visual questions, the authors find that entity misrecognition causes 76.3% of errors and propose ClueRL, a reinforcement learning method that rewards attention to entity-recall visual clues.

memory.title: State Space Attention: Learning Context-Dependent Memory Retention
memory.summary: Introduces State Space Attention, a sequence model that learns which bounded set of past representations to retain and reads them with standard attention, reporting results on retrieval and reasoning benchmarks against full-attention Transformers.

memory.title: Leto: Utility-Centric Agent Memory

memory.title: Skip the DRAM Tier: MoRI UMBP Runs the Agentic KV Cache on NVMe

A KV cache hit means the prefill node only has to process the small delta. A miss forces a full recomputation of the prefix, which burns GPU time and delays the first token.
